newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: CZECH BOMBER CRASHES APPARENTLY KILLING PILOT - CTK.
newsitem.headline: CZECH BOMBER CRASHES APPARENTLY KILLING PILOT - CTK.

text.p: A Soviet-made Su-22 M4 fighter/bomber aircraft on a training mission for the Czech army crashed in the southeastern Czech Republic on Friday apparently killing the pilot, the Czech CTK agency reported.

It quoted a Defense Ministry spokesman as saying the plane crashed mid-morning in an unpopulated area near the town of Tasovice na Blanensku, roughly 200 km (125 miles) southeast of Prague. A cause of the crash was not given.
CTK quoted a police source as saying the pilot was killed instantly and only part of his body so far could be found by a rescue team.
No other personnel on the plane, if any were on board, were mentioned in the report, and ministry officials were not immediately available for further comment.
